text:
vivian: Heads-up — onboarding warmup sample (bulk-embeds) is causing burst 429s and then a synchronized retry storm when users set batch=64 + concurrency=8. Repro on node/js-sdk.

omar: Oof. Do we know if it's token quota or concurrent request cap?

vivian: It's concurrency plus queue coalescing. The app queues many chunks then blasts them; SDK retries are low-variance so retries line up. Edge sends Retry-After (seconds) but SDK bulk path ignores it.

lee: can you paste the minimal repro?

vivian: snippet:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, maxConcurrency: 8 });
await client.embeddings.bulkCreate({ items: bigChunks, batchSize: 64 });
```

omar: quick diagnosis: three problems — (1) no client-side token budgeting so many large batches count as one slot, (2) bulk endpoints ignore Retry-After and fall back to deterministic backoff, (3) retry jobs re-acquire the same semaphore and can deadlock with paginator.

lee: suggested fixes: implement a fair-share semaphore that charges estimateTokens(batch) when acquiring; honor Retry-After for bulk endpoints (seconds and HTTP-date formats); switch bulk to full jittered exponential backoff; separate retry queue with lower priority so retries don't starve forward progress.

vivian: also add sample-app conservative defaults: --warmup (batch 24, concurrency 3) and opt-in fast mode via RW_ONBOARD_FAST=true. Add explanation in quickstart about "burst amortization" and warmup tradeoffs.

omar: infra note: we'll keep returning Retry-After but can add a transient onboarding token bucket to avoid hammering new orgs while we roll SDK fixes.

docs-bot: created DX-4032 "warmup: queue-coalesce & fair-share semaphore" assigned @omar
docs-bot: https://redwood/dx/4032

lee: tests: add e2e harness that simulates rate-limit responses with varied Retry-After and assert retries spread across a window; unit test parse for Retry-After in both formats.

vivian: parity reminder: ensure Go/Android/iOS implement same semantics. Users were confused because iOS had a small semaphore and honored Retry-After, android ignored Retry-After but had jitter — inconsistent UX. We want consistent behavior across SDKs.

omar: I'll own the Node SDK patch (semaphore-by-tokens, honor Retry-After, jitter) and coordinate with platform for the transient onboarding bucket. Lee, can you update sample app and quickstart?

lee: yes, will add a short note and an opt-in fast flag. Also adding DEBUG=S DK:throttle guidance and a header X-RW-CLIENT-SLOTS in debug to help infra correlate bursts without leaking keys.

vivian: temporary mitigation for QA: set sample to concurrency 2 and insert a 100ms gap between enqueues; that prevents the second-wave 429s until SDK update lands.

omar: thanks — will open PR today. If anyone hits the issue, paste DEBUG logs here and include X-RW-CLIENT-SLOTS.
